articles.title: Smaller AI Models Suffice For Brain-Language Studies, Says IIIT-H Study
articles.description: Researchers found models with about 3 billion parameters perform almost as well as those with up to 14 billion, potentially reducing the computing power needed for brain research.
articles.content:
